jobs.description: Are you ready for a hands-on technical role where every day brings new challenges and the chance to work with cutting-edge CNC technology? Join a leading international production company and be part of a team that shapes aluminum components for clients worldwide. Wie zoeken we? Technical experience or insight in a manufacturing or production environment Willingness to work shifts (3-shift system) Own transportation (the site has limited public transport access) Fluency in Dutch, English, or German A curious, precise, and growth-oriented mindset Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour (including allowances - see below for the breakdown) Full-time, 37.5 hours a week in 3-shift rotation Travel reimbursement Full onboarding and personal coaching to get you up to speed Chance to move to a permanent contract once you've proven yourself Room to develop yourself through training and growth opportunities A friendly, professional team with people from all over the world How does the salary work? Your base hourly rate is €16.06. You get a 120% bonus on every hour you work - whether that's early shifts, late shifts, or nights. So €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. Plus, you get €0.91 per hour in ADV on top of that: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving As a CNC Operator, you'll be responsible for running our production process and ensuring every part meets our high-quality standards. Here's what you'll be doing: Setting up, calibrating, and running our CNC machines Turning raw aluminum into precise, high-quality components based on technical drawings Checking quality with calipers, micrometers, and other measuring tools Finishing parts with sanding, grinding, and cleaning Assembling and packaging products ready to ship out We're looking for someone with production operator experience. We'll provide comprehensive training to ensure you're fully equipped for the role. Ready to apply? Click the button below.
